title: Prediction Sample
description: A sample record used for model training or inference, anchored to an event cycle.

sample_id.description: Unique identifier for the prediction sample.

cycle_id.description: Identifier of the event cycle this sample is derived from.

stock_id.description: Identifier of the stock this sample pertains to.

prediction_date.description: ISO-8601 date for which the prediction is made.

cutoff_time.description: ISO-8601 timestamp after which no data is used (point-in-time boundary).

days_since_last_event.description: Calendar days since the last LHB event in the cycle.

dataset_version.description: Version tag of the dataset this sample belongs to.

feature_schema_hash.description: Hash of the feature schema used to generate this sample.

label_policy_hash.description: Hash of the label policy used to assign ground-truth labels.
